basic_info.description: Ideally situated at the crossroads of city charm and nature's beauty, this spacious one-bedroom corner flat offers the best of San Francisco living. Discover classic San Francisco details like original white oak floors and preserved wainscoting with modern touches. The formal dining room is a showstopper with box beam ceilings, original charming built-ins, and a decorative fireplaceperfect for entertaining.  The sunny living room is adjacent to the dining room and is spacious enough to host a party or fit a home office set up. The refreshed kitchen offers practical updates including stainless steel appliances, abundant storage, and durable but beautiful quartz countertops.    Abundant natural light floods the home through large corner windows, and an oversized hallway closet adds the kind of storage space rarely found in San Francisco flats. The tub-shower bathroom is simple and appealing, while the bright bedroom provides a peaceful retreat.    Downstairs, enjoy an expansive private storage room and your own private one-car garage. Shared laundry completes this home.    Just a quick stroll to Golden Gate Park, including the De Young Museum, Academy of Sciences, and the enchanting Botanical Gardens, this home is the epitome of Inner Richmond living.
